summary: Implemented the spec in the repo, without running any code or tests and without committing. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__, which walks expanded nodes, adds a 4-cell guide prefix per nesting level to each label's measurement, and clamps to max_width; added the Measurement import. (2) rich/align.py: VerticalCenter did not exist in the repo, so I created it with __init__(renderable, style=None), a __rich_console__ that pads rendered lines above and below to console.height (top gets the rounded-down half), and a __rich_measure__ that delegates to the renderable. (3) CHANGELOG.md: added an Unreleased entry for both. Not done: no tests were added (the checklist asks for them), and nothing was verified by execution. Nothing committed.
